title: Ready-to-wear looks
caption: Dress your hero in one click: a space marine with a sealed visor, an astronaut, starship crew, a neon Glow runner and a street samurai.

title: Centaurs and more
caption: Meet the new centaur, plus insectfolk with compound eyes, the two-headed Hydrata, catfolk and werewolves, all wearing the same outfits as everyone else.

title: Eagles, bats and big cats
caption: The rebuilt bald eagle glides on spread wings with a feathered head and hooked beak, joined by rebuilt bats, lions and tigers.

title: Rebuilt vehicles
caption: Motorcycles and trucks come with real wheels, doors and headlights, and body styles you can tune with a few sliders.

title: Trees in bloom
caption: Plant oaks, cherry blossoms and weeping willows that change with the seasons and sway in the wind.

title: Sprite sheets from 3D
caption: Export a walking character with six frames per step, or a tree that sways in eight frames, ready for your 2D maps.

title: Paint roads on 3D maps
caption: Drag the Path tool to lay dirt roads, cobblestone or paving that follow the hills through your village.

title: Search everything
caption: Type a word in the new toolbar Search to find structures, maps, switches and event text, grouped and one click away.
